summary: Renamed from P-ETH-1: consolidation fee/refund ETH plane only (orthogonal to P-CONSOLIDATION-1 vault request atomicity). eth_flow_parent (Wave 1): for all (msgValue, n, fee) classified against an ApprovedSet, msg.value=0 reverts ZeroArgument, n*fee≥2^256 reverts overflow, n*fee>msgValue reverts InsufficientValue, otherwise every move is parentApproved and totalAmount=msgValue. VaultHub/StakingVault.withdraw explicitly out of scope. Verity parent verity_tx_universal_success_shape now matches that quantifier strength on the success arm: for all (msgValue, batchSize, feePerRequest) that are nonzero-valued, word-sized, non-wrapping in the product fee, funded (batchSize*feePerRequest ≤ msgValue), and fuel-fit (batchSize+4 ≤ fuelBudget=32), the honest wiring commits with the whole product fee at the consolidation-request predeploy, the remainder at the refund recipient, and zero retained by every protocol contract on the route; proved by frame-by-frame chaining through the recursive dispatcher. The premises are exactly the abstract parent's non-revert conditions plus the model's fuel bound, and each is load-bearing: premise-necessity kill-lines refute the premise-dropped projections on the honest wiring (zero-value (0,2,0), underfunded (10,4,3), fuel (30,29,1) witnesses), and four wiring mutants (dropped refund leg, misrouted vault leg, corrupted refund amount, single request per batch) refute the same universal predicate at the premise-satisfying witness (10,2,3). The five numeral witnesses, rejecting-predeploy rollback, underfunded revert, ETH conservation, and dispatch/multicall replay agreement are retained as auxiliary regression evidence (verity_tx_composes_value_flow_and_rollback). Wave 6 closes the quantifier gap on the other side of the guard: verity_tx_universal_revert_partition proves UniversalRevertPartition, four ∀-quantified rollback arms read through observe (hence through finalWorld, so each arm asserts transaction-entry rollback of the whole balance sheet, not merely a control tag) — msgValue=0 reverts at the gateway after 2 hops for all word-sized (batchSize, feePerRequest); 2^256 ≤ batchSize*feePerRequest reverts at the gateway for all nonzero-valued word-sized inputs with 0 < batchSize; msgValue < batchSize*feePerRequest (non-wrapping) reverts at the gateway; and a funded non-wrapping batch with 29 ≤ batchSize needing more than fuelBudget frames exhausts dispatch at fuelBudget hops with the sender's whole msgValue restored. That partition is conjoined into the registered verity_tx_success_and_revert_partition alongside the four numeral witnesses it subsumes, so the registered claim is strictly strengthened and no prior witness is dropped. verity_tx_universal_zero_remainder_boundary covers the batchSize+3 = fuelBudget zero-remainder corner excluded by the success parent's conservative batchSize+4 ≤ fuelBudget premise, so together the success arm, the boundary corner, and the four revert arms classify every word-sized input. Wave 4 parent kill-lines refute eth_flow_parent's own success conjunct on mutants of gatewayExecute itself: misrouted_journal_kill_line_refutes_parent (fee legs journaled to an off-ApprovedSet address, classified .other) and zero_value_success_kill_line_refutes_parent (guard-free gateway succeeds at msg.value=0 paying 2*3=6 wei of fees, breaking totalAmount=msgValue). Former P-CONSOLIDATION-ETH-1b fee-leg theorems are demoted to parent evidence under A-CANONICAL-REQUEST-ADDRESS rather than a sibling guarantee. Former P-CONSOLIDATION-ETH-1a (vault→Lido/WQ return confinement) is retired from this parent: it matches neither the consolidation fee/refund happy path nor P-RESERVE-1 spend accounting.

theorems.name: LidoSRv3.Audit.Guarantees.PConsolidationEth1.eth_flow_parent_at_canonical
theorems.doc:
/-- **P-CONSOLIDATION-ETH-1, abstract plane.** At the canonical request
predeploy, for every `(msgValue, n, fee)`: zero value, wrapping fee and
underfunding revert, and otherwise every wei goes to the request contract or
the refund recipient with the total equal to `msgValue`.

**Registry-facing abstract parent at the canonical request predeploy.**
This folds the fee destination into the parent conclusion instead of leaving
the canonical target only in sibling evidence.  The literal is model content;
its equality with the deployed configured target remains
`A-CANONICAL-REQUEST-ADDRESS`. -/
theorems.statement:
theorem eth_flow_parent_at_canonical (refundRecipient : Address)
    (hDistinct : refundRecipient ≠ canonicalRequestAddress) :
    (canonicalApprovedSet refundRecipient).consolidationContract = canonicalRequestAddress ∧
      ∀ (msgValue n fee : Nat),
        GatewayOutcomeClassified (canonicalApprovedSet refundRecipient) msgValue n fee

theorems.role: registered Verity Executable Contract parent (audit/guarantees.yaml verity.theorem)
theorems.name: LidoSRv3.Audit.Guarantees.PConsolidationEth1.verity_tx_success_and_revert_partition
theorems.doc:
/-- **P-CONSOLIDATION-ETH-1, Verity plane.** For every funded, word-sized,
fuel-fit batch the Bus/Gateway/Vault ensemble commits the whole product fee at
the request predeploy and the remainder at the refund recipient; it rolls back
at the four modeled non-success boundaries (zero value, wrapped product,
underfunding, fuel exhaustion), both on the four concrete witnesses and at full
`∀`-quantifier strength (`UniversalRevertPartition`).

Registry-facing Verity close: the universal funded success shape conjoined
with executable rollback shapes at all four modeled non-success boundaries
(zero value, wrapped product, underfunding, and dispatch-fuel exhaustion), both
as the four exact numeral witnesses and — since Wave 6 — at full
`∀`-quantifier strength via `UniversalRevertPartition`.

**Chantier 2 (Thomas 2026-09-13, item a) fee-STATICCALL wiring: statement
change.** The per-request fee is no longer a free `Nat` input; the parent
now consumes an `LidoSRv3.Audit.Source.ConsolidationFeeStaticcallSource
.PredeployStaticcallResult` and uses `result.abiDecodedFee` as the
per-request fee. This wires the pinned Solidity fee source
(`WithdrawalVaultEIP7685.sol:79-93`,
`_getFeeFromContract(CONSOLIDATION_REQUEST)`) into the registered Verity
parent's statement directly: a caller composing the parent must supply a
`PredeployStaticcallResult` naming the EIP-7251 predeploy STATICCALL
return, not an arbitrary Nat. The proof is unchanged — `result.abiDecodedFee`
is still a `Nat`, so the underlying frame-by-frame chaining through
`Verity.PConsolidationEth1CompositionTxUniversal.run_success_shape` and
`Verity.PConsolidationEth1CompositionTxUniversalRevert` carries. -/
theorems.statement:
theorem verity_tx_success_and_revert_partition
    (msgValue batchSize : Nat)
    (result : _root_.LidoSRv3.Audit.Source.ConsolidationFeeStaticcallSource.PredeployStaticcallResult)
    (hpos : 0 < msgValue)
    (hmv : msgValue < _root_.Verity.Core.Uint256.modulus)
    (hnM : batchSize < _root_.Verity.Core.Uint256.modulus)
    (hfee : result.abiDecodedFee < _root_.Verity.Core.Uint256.modulus)
    (hnf : batchSize * result.abiDecodedFee <
      _root_.Verity.Core.Uint256.modulus)
    (hle : batchSize * result.abiDecodedFee ≤ msgValue)
    (hfuel : batchSize + 4 ≤ fuelBudget) :
    UniversalSuccessShape msgValue batchSize result.abiDecodedFee ∧
      RevertsOnZeroValue ∧
      RevertsOnWrappedFee ∧
      RevertsOnUnderfunding ∧
      ExhaustsFuelAndRollsBack ∧
      UniversalRevertPartition

**chantier 2 gateway ABI-bridge arithmetic** (Thomas 2026-09-13, LidoSRv3/Audit/Source/ConsolidationFeeStaticcallSource.lean): `gatewayTotalFee result requestsCount = requestsCount * result.abiDecodedFee` names the `totalFee = requestsCount * fee` computation at `ConsolidationGateway.sol:212` on top of the STATICCALL result. `gatewayTotalFee_ne_zero_of_fee_ne_zero` derives the Thomas 2026-09-13 `fee ≠ 0 → totalFee ≠ 0` bridge (positive `requestsCount` + nonzero STATICCALL-return `fee` → nonzero forwarded `totalFee`, pure arithmetic). `gatewayTotalFee_zero_at_fee_zero` documents the `fee = 0` on-chain path where the assumption is violable (any batch forwards `totalFee = 0`). `gatewayTotalFee_ne_zero_witness` is a concrete `⟨7⟩ 3 ≠ 0` non-vacuity witness. This is the arithmetic side of the `A-CONSOLIDATION-GATEWAY-NONZERO` reformulation the assumption body now cites; the gateway→vault ABI/interpreter bridge remains a separate composition gap.

**chantier 2 gateway→vault ABI-bridge linkage** (Thomas 2026-09-13, LidoSRv3/Audit/Source/ConsolidationFeeStaticcallSource.lean): `gatewayVaultBoundary result requestsCount` names the two scalars that cross the gateway→vault frame boundary at `ConsolidationGateway.sol:220` (`withdrawalVault.addConsolidationRequests{value: totalFee}(sourcePubkeys, targetPubkeys)`): `msgValue = gatewayTotalFee result requestsCount` and `fee = result.abiDecodedFee`. `gatewayVaultBoundary_satisfies_exact_fee` proves `msgValue = requestsCount * fee` — exactly the arithmetic identity that the vault-side `_requireExactFee` guard (`WithdrawalVaultEIP7685.sol:123-127`, `IncorrectFee` revert) checks. A caller composing this ETH-1 leg with the P-CONSOLIDATION-1 vault leg now has an explicit source-plane linkage: populating `Inputs.msgValue` and `Inputs.fee` from `gatewayVaultBoundary` makes the vault's `IncorrectFee` revert unreachable, so the vault commits on the count / bound / per-key-validation guards alone. `gatewayVaultBoundary_witness` is a concrete `⟨7⟩ 3` example (`msgValue = 21`, `fee = 7`). Full Verity/executable composition (an actual `Contract.run` chaining `ConsolidationGateway.addConsolidationRequests` to `WithdrawalVault.addConsolidationRequests` at the frame-transition boundary) remains OPEN and is disclosed as such in `fidelity.missing`.

**chantier 2 (Thomas 2026-09-13, item a) fee-STATICCALL wiring — registered-parent statement change**. The registered Verity parent `verity_tx_success_and_revert_partition` in `LidoSRv3/Audit/Guarantees/PConsolidationEth1.lean` has been REWIRED: the per-request fee input is no longer a free `Nat`; the parent now takes an `LidoSRv3.Audit.Source.ConsolidationFeeStaticcallSource.PredeployStaticcallResult` and uses `result.abiDecodedFee` as the per-request fee in the `UniversalSuccessShape` conjunct and the four `hfee`/`hnf`/`hle` premises. The pinned Solidity fee source (`WithdrawalVaultEIP7685.sol:79-93`, `_getFeeFromContract(CONSOLIDATION_REQUEST)` STATICCALL on the EIP-7251 predeploy `0x0000BBdDc7CE488642fb579F8B00f3a590007251`) is now named in the registered parent's statement itself, not as an isolated scaffold module. Callers composing the parent must supply a `PredeployStaticcallResult` rather than an arbitrary `Nat`; the previous `PConsolidationEth1FeeStaticcallPremise.feePerRequest_derived_from_staticcall_result` linkage becomes a definitional identity on the parent's fee input. Proof body unchanged — `result.abiDecodedFee : Nat` still discharges the frame-by-frame chaining through `Verity.PConsolidationEth1CompositionTxUniversal.run_success_shape` and `verity_tx_universal_revert_partition`. Residual multi-session Verity model builds (live-STATICCALL executable frame, 32-byte ABI decoder, EIP-7251 fee-schedule model) remain disclosed in `fidelity.missing`; those turn `PredeployStaticcallResult` from a named input structure into a function of the actual on-chain STATICCALL execution.

chantier 5 pause guard (mandate 2026-09-12), chantier 2 physical composition (Thomas 2026-09-13): the `whenResumed` modifier (ConsolidationGateway.sol:188, contract-level pausable state) is composed via `PhysicalEntrySettlement.Admitted` in the physical-plane theorem `actual_physical_entry_quota_settlement_requests` — a paused gateway does not satisfy `Admitted` and therefore never reaches the modeled arms. Registered subordinate evidence rather than a parent conjunct; a live pausable-slot decoder binding remains OPEN.

chantier 5 quota guard (mandate 2026-09-12), chantier 2 physical composition (Thomas 2026-09-13): the gateway's live quota check at ConsolidationGateway.sol:209 (`_consumeConsolidationRequestLimit(requestsCount)`) is modeled by the physical-plane `PhysicalQuotaSettlement` module (`audit/trio/consolidation/PhysicalQuotaSettlement.lean`), and the theorem `actual_physical_quota_settlement_requests` (LidoSRv3/Audit/Guarantees/PConsolidationEth1PhysicalQuota.lean) derives, on the executed committed run, `PhysicalQuotaSettlement.prepare = .ok requestsCount`, the transition function's `.ok` outcome, `QuotaEffects` (storage after the quota update), and the downstream settlement chain. A quota-exceeded batch fails `PhysicalQuotaSettlement.prepare` before any modeled arm fires. Registered subordinate evidence rather than a parent conjunct.

chantier 5 CL proof guard (mandate 2026-09-12), chantier 2 cross-guarantee composition (Thomas 2026-09-13, item d.CL): `_validatePubKeyWCProof` (`CLProofVerifier.sol:150-175`, called at `ConsolidationGateway.sol:206`) performs (i) `_verifySlot(witness)` — slot/proposer parity check against `witness.proof`, (ii) leaf construction `sha256Pair(pubkeyRoot(pubkey), withdrawalCredentials)`, (iii) gindex composition `concat(GI_STATE_ROOT, concat(_getValidatorGI(validatorIndex, slot), GI_PUBKEY_WC_PARENT))`, and (iv) `SSZ.verifyProof(proof, root=_getParentBlockRoot(childBlockTimestamp), leaf, gI)`. Cross-guarantee composition entry point registered: `LidoSRv3.Audit.Guarantees.PConsolidationEth1CLProofPremise.cl_proof_derived_under_pinned_cl_proof_shape` — under `PinnedCLProofShape input` (leaf matches `validatorHashTreeRoot`, `verifyProof` succeeds, EIP-4788 anchor is canonical), derives the two P-SSZ-1 parent conclusions the ETH-1 gateway consumer needs: the `SSZ.verifyProof` Merkle-fold iff (conjunct 3 of `real_validator_correspondence`) and the EIP-4788 anchor targeting `beaconRootsAddress` (conjunct 4). Load-bearing on the shape premise; consumes `real_validator_correspondence` from P-SSZ-1. Non-vacuity witness `cl_proof_derived_witness` shows the shape is satisfied by any input where the pinned `_validatorHashTreeRoot` leaf reduces the Merkle fold to the claimed root at the canonical EIP-4788 anchor. Full Verity composition into `PhysicalEntrySettlement`'s per-group gate remains OPEN — needs (a) a Verity model of `_validatePubKeyWCProof`'s executable frame on `Live.World`, (b) a cross-guarantee Verity theorem, (c) an ABI decoder for `sha256Pair(pubkeyRoot(pubkey), withdrawalCredentials)` on the gateway's calldata; disclosed as residual in `fidelity.missing`.

chantier 5 fee STATICCALL (mandate 2026-09-12), chantier 2 wiring (Thomas 2026-09-13, item a): the vault's `_getConsolidationRequestFee` (WithdrawalVaultEIP7685.sol:79-81 → `_getFeeFromContract(CONSOLIDATION_REQUEST)`) reads the live fee via STATICCALL on the CONSOLIDATION_REQUEST address. The registered Verity parent's fee input is now NAMED as `PredeployStaticcallResult.abiDecodedFee` in the statement itself (see fidelity.covered), not as a free caller-supplied Nat. What remains OPEN is the live executable model that would compute `PredeployStaticcallResult` from an actual on-chain STATICCALL — a `Contract.run` STATICCALL frame on the pinned EIP-7251 predeploy `0x0000BBdDc7CE488642fb579F8B00f3a590007251`, plus a 32-byte ABI decoder for the return-data fee word, plus an EIP-7251 fee-schedule model.

model_not_deployment: These are proofs about a model, not about a deployed contract.
The subject is a Lean model of Staking Router v3, written against pinned source lidofinance/core@17005714f151e5502c559932319a3f2f74ac2436.

No theorem here binds to deployed bytecode, a runtime codehash, a constructor, or a chain address. The SRv3 contracts are deployed on mainnet with lidofinance/core v4.0.0 (2026-07-24; StakingRouter proxy 0xFdDf38947aFB03C621C71b06C9C70bce73f12999, TopUpGateway proxy 0x3FC2C71579D80790Aaa3fc7Be8B66ac39dC57374); the theorems still speak about the model, not about that deployment.
CHECKED means *the named Lean theorem builds*. It does not mean audited, verified on chain, or closed.
